definitions.explanation: Warm-blooded vertebrate animals with feathers, beaks, and wings. The class Aves in biological classification.

examples.japanese: {鳥類|ちょうるい}は{羽毛|うもう}を{持|も}っています。
ペンギンも{鳥類|ちょうるい}の{一種|いっしゅ}です。
examples.english: Penguins are also a type of bird.

examples.japanese: {鳥類|ちょうるい}の{多|おお}くは{空|そら}を{飛|と}ぶことができます。

notes:
{鳥類|ちょうるい} is the scientific classification term for birds.

{鳥|ちょう} means "bird" and {類|るい} means "class/category."

Note: In everyday speech, {鳥|とり} is used. {鳥類|ちょうるい} is more formal/scientific.

Characteristics of birds:
- {羽毛|うもう} (feathers)
- {嘴|くちばし} (beak)
- {卵|たまご}を{産|う}む (lay eggs)

Related classification terms:
- {哺乳類|ほにゅうるい} (mammals)
- {爬虫類|はちゅうるい} (reptiles)
- {魚類|ぎょるい} (fish)
